free_text.text: Global macro system for paths and variable lists
Setup loads packages; General-FM-parameters prepares radio data; Programs.ado defines spatial estimators; ROBUST.do panel FE with robust SE; CONLEY.do spatial HAC.
Global macros for data, code, tables, figures directories (${dropbox}, ${data}, ${code}, ${temp_data}, ${tables}, ${figures})
Eligible borrowers: type==1 borrowers in baseline and 2016 endline, or eligible_2017==1 in 2017 endline
Analysis restricted to el_eligible==1 sample

Read entry script (Master.do), build pipeline (baseline_prepare, endline_prepare, endline_2_prepare), analysis scripts (survey_analysis.do, loan_analysis.R, three_period_sim.R), and balance test script. Covered treatment assignment, main specifications with randomization inference, outcomes, and structural model setup. Did not read full outcome table construction or detailed R simulation implementation due to file size.
interaction with epsilonit (intermediary exposure)
two-way clustering (permno, date)
multiple shock types tested
Fixed effects specification: ab(permno date) notation in reghdfe specifies stock-by-time two-way FE absorption
Interaction syntax: c.intermediary_shock#c.epsilonit creates fully-interacted term
Portfolio-level analysis: data aggregated to quintile × date level before ivreg2 estimation
Output names: figures exported as .png in Figures/ subdirectory; tables as .tex in Tables/ subdirectory

Analyzed master scripts and key analysis/cleaning scripts; found consistent patterns in reghdfe specifications with cluster(permno date) two-way clustering and date/stock FE; xtfmb in Table 1; ivreg2 with Newey-West HAC in portfolio regressions and event study; identified main data sources (CRSP, Compustat, FactSet, FF factors, S34)
Fixed effects at program level (codigo_prog)
Multiple sets of controls (models a-f)
Model a: individual baseline characteristics
Model f: adds prior school and college peer characteristics
Bandwidth stored in global macro after rdrobust call (${bw_r}, ${br_r}) for reuse in heterogeneous subgroup analysis to ensure consistency
Sampling conditions stored as global macros: ${cond_saber11} = 'eligible_sisben==1', ${cond_sisben} = 'eligible_saber11==1'
matrix ry2014 stores rdrobust results for table/figure production
Data loading source: ${data}/data_RD and ${data2}/PILA_cuatrimestral datasets not publicly available in code

Entry point: Master.do calls 2 input scripts (3_Results_years_PILA.do, 4_value_added_model.do) then 16 figure/table scripts. Main estimation conducted through rdrobust command (37 hits) with two running variables (running_saber11, running_sisben). Identified 3 specification families: reduced-form RD, fuzzy RD with beneficiary_spp instrument, and value-added model with reghdfe. Budget exhausted at 7 of 32 code files; remaining scripts (Fig_4_5.do, Fig_6.do, Fig_7_8.do, etc.) follow identical rdro

Inventory-first survey of master script, README, programs_desc.md, and exhibit_source_map.md; sampled 6 key files (README, data/program descriptions, one Stata analysis, two MATLAB model scripts). Trade model structure and data sources fully traced; model calibrations (5 variants) and shock scenarios (uniform, autarky, revealed 1997->2007) identified; main output tables/figures mapped to source programs. Estimation details and local robustness robustness scripts not fully covered due to budget.
Triangular kernel weighting: max(1-tribdist/h, 0)
Running variable: tribdist_signed (signed distance to tributary confluence)
Bandwidth selection via rdbwselect (optimal MSE-RD, CCD)
Clustered bootstrap for standard errors (1000 replications)
Fixed effects absorbed (not shown in coefficient table) via absorb() option

Master script calls prelim.do (requires ArcGIS/Matlab preprocessing) then analysis scripts. Focus on tract-level quasi-RDD and county-level panel analysis identified; out-of-budget on full lag structure enumeration and robustness specifications.
Data years 2012-2020

Focused on core estimation pipeline: data build (Stata), first-stage CCPs (logit/plant evolution), reduced-form analysis (PPMLHDFE deterrence), and structural model (SMM with SLSQP). Skipped post-estimation visualization scripts and Mathematica. Reduced-form panel FE models appear to be exploratory rather than main results.

notes: Observed practices only. Shares are among papers whose card records a known value; null/unknown/not_found_in_scope are never counted as absence. Recommendations live in recommendations.md and require method sources and review.
